children: FreeCast, Inc. (

), a provider of white-label streaming entertainment technology, today introduced True Voice AI, an intelligent entertainment assistant to be built into the FreeCast Watch App in coming days. Testing currently live on FreeCast's web interface, the new conversational interface will help viewers discover movies, television series, sports and related entertainment information by describing what they want, even when they remember only part of a title, an actor, a scene or a storyline.

True Voice AI extends discovery beyond the boundaries of a single streaming service, network or studio. Through natural-language voice and chat interactions, users can explore entertainment across supported services, refine their requests through follow-up conversations and find available viewing options in one place.

The introduction brings practical AI capabilities into FreeCast’s reusable Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS), enabling telecom operators, internet service providers, residential communities and consumer brands to incorporate conversational discovery into their own branded entertainment offerings.
Turning Fragments of a Memory Into Viewing Options
Finding something to watch can require searching multiple apps, remembering an exact title or knowing which service carries a particular program. True Voice AI is designed to simplify that process.

Viewers can begin with the details they remember, then use conversational prompts to narrow the results. The assistant helps connect those requests with relevant entertainment and information about where and how to watch. Where supported links are available, viewers can proceed to the service offering the content.

“Consumers often remember a scene, an actor or a few words, but not the title or which service has it,” said William Mobley, CEO of FreeCast. “True Voice AI lets them start with what they know and continue the conversation until they find something they want to watch. We are integrating that convenience into a broader entertainment platform that our partners can offer under their own brands.”
An Intelligent Assistant Inside the FreeCast Watch App
True Voice AI combines several discovery capabilities in one interface:
Broad entertainment discovery: Search across movies, series, sporting events, scores, actors and historical entertainment information, subject to supported data sources and service coverage.
Multilingual voice interaction: Supported language options help serve diverse language communities throughout the United States and internationally.
Conversational refinement: Follow-up prompts guide and narrow results without requiring users to start a new search.
Voice input across supported platforms: Spoken requests provide a quick, direct way to navigate entertainment discovery.
Remote-friendly suggested responses: Selectable on-screen buttons anticipate relevant next steps and make conversations easier to navigate with a television remote.
Accessible chat history: Users can return to previous conversations and pick up where they left off.
One Platform, Reusable Across Partner Brands

FreeCast’s PaaS combines entertainment discovery with access to free programming, paid streaming options and subscription-management capabilities. True Voice AI adds conversational interaction to that existing platform rather than requiring partners to assemble a separate discovery product.

The shared white-label model is designed to reduce duplicative development, integration and maintenance work for partners seeking to offer a branded entertainment experience. It also provides FreeCast with a reusable capability that can support multiple partner deployments.

“Our partners already have customer relationships and established brands,” Mobley added. “FreeCast gives them an integrated entertainment platform they can make their own. By incorporating AI discovery into that shared infrastructure, we aim to help partners deliver greater consumer convenience while reducing the need to build and maintain comparable capabilities independently.”

FreeCast views easier discovery as a way to support customer activation, engagement and exploration of free and paid entertainment within partner-branded platforms. Any resulting commercial benefits will depend on partner deployment, consumer adoption, usage and applicable business arrangements.

Feature availability, language support, content coverage and functionality vary by supported platform, service and market. Discovery does not include subscription rights; paid content requires permissioned access to the consumer's own separate subscriptions.
About FreeCast, Inc.
FreeCast, Inc. (

) provides a Platform-as-a-Service for branded streaming entertainment experiences. Its technology brings together content discovery, free and paid programming, subscription management and monetization capabilities for telecom operators, internet service providers, residential communities and consumer brands. Learn more at www.freecast.com.
